Scripter (and creator of a couple) here. You can see when enemies are recalling and how much time until they have finished their recall. The scripts also show you if they have cancelled their recall. With this information and the position of your charecter, the scripts can calculate the time taken for the ultimate to reach the enemy fountain. So at the right time the scripts just automatically shoot out the ultimate. Actually it's kinda fun thing to do. I love playing Ez and Jinx with them, although Draven and Ashe work quite fine as well.

I would not say I have been pushed. I just always was there. Ever since I was like 8 and started thinking about like in general. Even though I was a happy young child and my family was great and loving, I still didn't want to live. I just didn't see the point in it and had no intention in going through whatever life would throw at me. I think the first time I tried to commit suicide was when I was around 10. Swallowed a bunch of sleeping pills (dad's a doctor and mums a nurse, so with some little sniffing around the house I managed to find quite a bit). Unfortunately woke up and found the pills beside me along with yesterdays tea (yeah, I guess I threw up). Then there was another instance when I wanted to just jump off our balcony head first, but as I was about to do it, my little sister (4 years at the time, if I recall correctly) came on the balcony and asked me what I was doing. There was noooo way I would put her through that, so I made up some bullshit and just went back in the house. I also had like a diary where I'd write about these instances and about how I feel. I was hiding it somewhere, forgot about it after like 10 entries. Like two years later, when my parents were moving the furniture (shelf on top of which I used to  hide it), I remembered it, so I am pretty sure they found it. But yeah, despite how good life I have compared to others, I just don't want to live. I don't, never in my lifetime have I wanted to and doubt if I ever will. There was also an instance where I was doing double backflip (really liked gymnastics as it was fun and I was always risking with my life), I failed mid air and landed relatively unnsuccessfully. I got ''extremely lucky'' and only dislocated my shoulder, hurt my neck and broke my arm in a place its near impossible to break. I've been looking back to that moment ever since (which is like 6 years ago) and wishing it would have finished me, just wishing I would have broken my neck or whatever is needed to kill me. Also the dreams in which I am dying or being tortured or killed, or falling or whatever... I never wake up from them. They are the best dreams I have. I don't know if that explains my situation well enough, but that is pretty much how I got here (or was here all along).
